description: Real, measured wall-clock time of solve_tensormesh (Newton + direct/LU, dense-Jacobian default path) at increasing mesh resolution, B1 x Neo-Hookean, CPU (no GPU in this environment). Used to answer whether TensorMesh's current code can produce a result at torch-fem's own production sweep sizes (N=401...1401) without first writing an explicit sparse jac_fn.
note: Fit uses the last two points (N=31, N=51). Extrapolating to torch-fem's own smallest PRODUCTION resolution (N=401, 321,602 DOF) gives on the order of 10 days of CPU time for a single such solve -- this is the real basis for treating N=51 as the practical ceiling for the current dense-Jacobian default path, not a guess.
